episode: '1: Halloween: The Second Kiss, Part Two

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Did you want Denni to end up with Ben... Or Colt?
Who do you like better, Jessica or Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Fine. Fine! I took it, but I don't have it! I gave it to Jessica, but it was for a good reason!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What reason is that?!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: ...I was hitting on her.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `That's` your good reason?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That's[/i][/color] your good reason?!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Girls like it when you give them things! I figured if I gave her something nice, she'd go on a date with me!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: But all I got was a 'Thanks! This looks expensive!' and then that look of disgust on her face where her nose gets all crinkly...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I hate that look!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't believe you would do something that low...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Believe it.
A little while later, Monte climbs into the car and drives off...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, how are we going to find Jessica?
Just then, some of the stragglers from the party walk by...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Great news, guys! There's a backup Halloween party! Over at Hector's place! I just got a text blast on my phone for it!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Is it on land? Because I `hate` land parties!
nodes.text_bbcode: Is it on land? Because I [color=#3b78e2][i]hate[/i][/color] land parties!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: I overheard someone say that, like, `every` boy will be there...
nodes.text_bbcode: I overheard someone say that, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] boy will be there...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Bingo.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Where there's boys, there's Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let's intimidate him... Ryan steals a lot, but I don't think he's ever in it for the money...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He's usually in it for something much dumber...
Colt glares at Ryan...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Your little detective team done with its tea party? Heh...
Colt reaches in and grabs Ryan by the collar...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You have `no` idea where I've been the last few weeks...
nodes.text_bbcode: You have [color=#e23b3b][i]no[/i][/color] idea where I've been the last few weeks...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Or what I've seen...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If you don't give me that bracelet, I will `break... Your... Face!`
nodes.text_bbcode: If you don't give me that bracelet, I will [color=#e23b3b][i]break... Your... Face![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let's bribe him... Money is probably the only thing a tough guy like Ryan will respond to...
Ben steps up to the window and pulls out his wallet...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What will twenty dollars get me?
Ryan snatches the money from Ben's hand.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Nothing!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey! Give that back!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Or else what? You'll give me more money?
Monte returns...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Something the matter?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, this guy stole my bracelet!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Give this kid back his bracelet, punk! Or I'll throw you in jail and swallow the key!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine. We'll strike the kiss from the record for now. But only until I get the bracelet back.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fine by me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'll help you get it back, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know if I want your help...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But... But I guess you're all I've got...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If she's coming along, then I'm coming too!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! I `know` I don't want your help!
nodes.text_bbcode: No! I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] I don't want your help!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! Don't forget who tipped you off in the first place?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Guys, shut up for a second!
The room gets quiet! They can hear Ryan yelling from the front yard!
The three run out of the house...
And find Monte escorting Ryan toward his police car!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Take it easy, man! I twisted my ankle when I landed!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'll twist more than your ankle if you don't pipe down!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I'm telling you! You've got the wrong guy!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I saw who you were with! A purple-haired Bonnie! A green-haired Clyde! And that emotionally-draining robot! I know it was you who's been pranking me!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You're looking for a `different` pranking team!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're looking for a [color=#e23b3b][i]different[/i][/color] pranking team!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Save it, punk!
Monte stuffs Ryan into the back of his squad car...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: This is a police matter, miss...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know! We think your suspect may be guilty of more than just pranking! Permission to question?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: For this punk?! By all means, go ahead!
Monte rolls down the back window... Denni, Colt, and Ben stand around the door.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All right, Ryan! We know you took the bracelet! Where is it?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: How did you... I mean, uhh... What bracelet?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, Toothy! We know you took it!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I don't know what you're talking about!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you want for it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you doing? Don't offer him anything! If he doesn't confess, we'll make him pay the second he steps out of jail!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Like, with credit?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! With pain!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Guys, quick huddle?
Denni, Ben, and Colt huddle up...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He obviously took it! But how do we get a confession out of him?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's pretty obvious! We threaten him! Ryan knows the kind of pain I can dish out. It's not a fun pain!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How we get the confession `is` obvious, but in the opposite way! He's interested in valuables. That's why he's stealing!
nodes.text_bbcode: How we get the confession [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] obvious, but in the opposite way! He's interested in valuables. That's why he's stealing!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So all we have to do is offer him a small amount of money...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Easy for you to say!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You don't get to kiss me and just forget about it!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Semantics! Gentlemen, lower your testosterone! What I meant was 'Why don't we forget about the kiss, `for now?'`
nodes.text_bbcode: Semantics! Gentlemen, lower your testosterone! What I meant was 'Why don't we forget about the kiss, [color=#3b78e2][i]for now?'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We can talk about the kiss afterward... You know, later...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Much, `much` later...
nodes.text_bbcode: Much, [color=#3b78e2][i]much[/i][/color] later...

nodes.text: On Ben's front porch...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: The clock is ticking! One more minute!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Come on, guys!
The rebels climb onto the clothing rope and descend out of sight.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't believe those guys were hanging out in my room...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You might want to check your valuables. That Ryan guy steals `all the time!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You might want to check your valuables. That Ryan guy steals [color=#e23b3b][i]all the time![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The bracelet!
Ben bolts over to the dresser and throws open a drawer!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oh no! No no no no no NO!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oh no! No no no no no NO![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What is it? What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look...
Ben points at an empty jewelry box inside the drawer!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I had a piece of jewelry here... I got it for, uh...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: For my mom. It meant a lot to me... I... I was going to give it to her, to let her know how I felt about her. And now it's... It's gone... Ryan `stole` it!
nodes.text_bbcode: For my mom. It meant a lot to me... I... I was going to give it to her, to let her know how I felt about her. And now it's... It's gone... Ryan [color=#e23b3b][i]stole[/i][/color] it!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Come on! He's probably not that far off! Let's go get the bracelet back!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! Who cares about a dumb bracelet! There's still the issue of you, me, and Tweed here!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you a moron?! I don't own `any` tweed!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you a moron?! I don't own [color=#e23b3b][i]any[/i][/color] tweed!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Too bad because you just earned yourself a nickname! Tweed `is` happening!
nodes.text_bbcode: Too bad because you just earned yourself a nickname! Tweed [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] happening!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whatever. And there's no issue! Denni's with me!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's a lie! If she were with you, she wouldn't have said you two weren't a couple before she kissed me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Did you... Did you say that, Denni?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Technically,` I might have said it... But...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Technically,[/i][/color] I might have said it... But...

nodes.text: Denni sighs.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Look, why don't we just...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ben's right! The truth will set you free more than a rope made out of collared shirts!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You can't be serious! You know what Monte will do if they confess!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But I bet you know better than anyone, Colt, that running from your problems `isn't` the answer!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I bet you know better than anyone, Colt, that running from your problems [color=#3b78e2][i]isn't[/i][/color] the answer!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Low blow, Princess! This is totally different!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Uh, guys? As fun as it is to debate, this particular problem has a nightstick! Now everybody start tying blankets together for the rope!
Everyone but Denni and Ben collects clothes and blankets and starts forming a rope...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, Ben, I gave it the old college try... Even though I haven't been to college yet...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks. I didn't expect you to back me up...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt's right!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Figures...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Ben, but if Monte catches them, he'll be kicking in something other than pumpkins!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You guys should work on the rope!
Everyone but Ben collects clothes and blankets and starts forming a rope...
The three of them step back into the living room.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... I totally had that covered, Colt!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes, sir! I'm pumpkins your patience! I mean... I'm not testing your pumpkins!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What?!
Monte brings his foot back to kick in another pumpkin!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Stop! Stop!
Colt digs deep into his wallet and flashes the small deputy officer's badge that he received from Officer Monte...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Junior Detective Colt here!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I didn't recognize you without your shades, son!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't worry, Officer. Everything's under control.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You should always step forward, son! So I don't have to waste my time with these civilians!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes, sir!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You've got five minutes to clean out all stragglers! After that, I'm going in!
Denni nudges Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Junior Detective Colt here!
Colt digs deep into his wallet and flashes the small deputy officer's badge that he received from Officer Monte...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I didn't recognize you without your shades, son!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't worry, Officer. Everything's under control.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That's what I like to hear!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But I'm not standing here forever! You've got five minutes to clean out all stragglers! After that, I'm going in!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What my friend meant to say was...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Why are you talking to me, purple-haired non-conformist?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh... Come again?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Did I stutter?!
Monte brings his foot back to kick in another pumpkin!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Stop! Stop!
Colt digs deep into his wallet and flashes the small deputy officer's badge that he received from Officer Monte...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Junior Detective Colt here!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I didn't recognize you without your shades, son!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't worry, Officer. Everything's under control.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You should always step forward, son! Don't waste my time with these civilians!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes, sir!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You've got five minutes to clean out all stragglers! After that, I'm going in!
Suddenly, Ben's house is illuminated by red and blue police lights!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The cops!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: The feds!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Aliens! I'm too fragile for abduction!
Everyone scrambles to find a hiding place! Ben's house is filled with shouts of panic, thumping feet, and crashing dishes!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do I do? I can't be arrested! What if I have priors?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I think if you don't know what 'priors' actually means, you're in the clear... And you should probably answer the door!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh yeah!
Ben nervously heads to the front door. Denni follows Ben, and Colt follows Denni.
Ben opens the door...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Officer! Uh...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I know you and your fooligan friends are having a Halloween hootenanny! I `hate` Halloween!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know you and your fooligan friends are having a Halloween hootenanny! I [color=#e23b3b][i]hate[/i][/color] Halloween!

nodes.text: Monte kicks in one of the pumpkins on the porch!
Denni takes off her mask...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey! Not cool! We carved those!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Not only do I hate having to respond to calls about noise infractions, but every Halloween, I get ambushed by a team of prank-happy chumps!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: They're always sabotaging my vehicle! They stick bananas in my exhaust pipe! They put pumpkins behind my tires! They spray-paint `lewd` images on my door!
nodes.text_bbcode: They're always sabotaging my vehicle! They stick bananas in my exhaust pipe! They put pumpkins behind my tires! They spray-paint [color=#e23b3b][i]lewd[/i][/color] images on my door!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: One's got green hair, one's got purple hair, one's got a robot with him... It's like I'm being pranked by punks from the future!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That sounds like the rebel clique!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I know they're in there! You've got three minutes to clear everyone out, or I'll come in, and if I find those time-traveling scoundrels, I'll hold `you` accountable!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know they're in there! You've got three minutes to clear everyone out, or I'll come in, and if I find those time-traveling scoundrels, I'll hold [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] accountable!

nodes.text: Monte kicks in another pumpkin and glares at Ben!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't want him to destroy the meta-pumpkin Ben and I made together!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What are you waiting for, Clyde? Are you testing my patience?!
Ben's knees shake... Colt rolls his eyes.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Are you trying to make me angry?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Er... Er... Er...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's great, but it doesn't answer my question.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, I think you got your answer, Tweed...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She can't deny what she feels.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, I `can't` deny what I feel, Colt! And what I feel about you is...
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I [color=#3b78e2][i]can't[/i][/color] deny what I feel, Colt! And what I feel about you is...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's reassuring...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, come on! I know you liked that kiss!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I know you're not thinking straight cause you're angry at me!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're right! I `am` angry at you!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're right! I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] angry at you!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You see what I mean, Tweed... She's in denial!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think you got your answer, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: There's a girl with angel wings... And a bunny tail... And devil tights!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, Denni! That's a pretty princess gown!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks! I like your mish-mash of outfits!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, the boys are crazy for it! It's like I fried their hormones!
Denni waves over Ben and Colt...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nice find!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Looks like you got `her` identity right!
nodes.text_bbcode: Looks like you got [color=#e23b3b][i]her[/i][/color] identity right!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This is completely different!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh no... Don't tell me you're here because you want to sign up for the cheerleading team...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, and thanks. I heard that you ended up with Ben's bracelet...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That was Ben's?! I thought it was Jessica's!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No. I think it was all just a big misunderstanding. I was wondering... Do you think I could get it back? It means a lot to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'd totally give it to you, but I was on the front porch when that cop pulled up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He startled me, and I dropped the bracelet into the pumpkin!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What? Why didn't you pick it up?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, the cop was marching straight at me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I didn't want to scoop it out... All that pumpkin goop...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Not` worth ruining my manicure!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Not[/i][/color] worth ruining my manicure!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Which pumpkin was it?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The orange one! Why does that matter?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Monte was kicking the pumpkins! He might have destroyed the bracelet!
Denni starts to run out of the locker room when Taylor calls to her...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait, Denni! One more thing...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who told you I was here, anyway? Was it Jessica? Maria? Jill? Lovable $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't play dumb with me, or I'll demote you to the bottom of the pyramid so fast...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But I'm not on the cheer team...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, whoops, just a habit.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just don't tell anyone about me and Brendan like you promised!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I won't!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Whoa! I'm glad on not on the cheerleading team! I wouldn't want to have to face Taylor's wrath!
Denni leaves the locker room...
A few minutes later, Denni, Ben, and Colt rush up to Ben's front porch! All the pumpkins have been kicked in...
Looks like Amanda's trick was also Amanda's treat!
Try again and see what happens when Denni takes Jessica's deal...

menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's a relief! You're so nice!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh, you are too, for some reason...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know you're a reporter and all, so I'd hate to see this show up in the paper...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't write for the gossip section...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, I didn't even know there were other sections! That's so good to hear!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who would you tell?! Hello! You `write` for the newspaper! You would tell `everyone!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Who would you tell?! Hello! You [color=#3b78e2][i]write[/i][/color] for the newspaper! You would tell [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm not going to...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't play naive with me! Promise me you won't tell anyone!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I promise!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And now we have reporter-cheerleader privilege, so you `have` to keep that promise.
nodes.text_bbcode: And now we have reporter-cheerleader privilege, so you [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to keep that promise.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's not a thing...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It is now! It means you don't report it, and I don't make your life a total nightmare! That's your privilege!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Great...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I wish I could get Ben to see how sorry I am!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Stalling or not, I have to find Taylor... I'll be back.
Denni steps into the girls' locker room. She walks past a row of lockers and sees a guy and a girl kissing!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh! I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Whoa! Wait! Taylor?! Brendan?! You guys are...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `Yagggg!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yagggg![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Brendan quickly stands up!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So, to continue with the inventory of the cheerleaders'... Inventory. That was eleven pom-poms?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uhhhh... Yeah, um... Get me more pom-poms, nerd! We can't have only eleven! Every cheerleader has `two` hands!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uhhhh... Yeah, um... Get me more pom-poms, nerd! We can't have only eleven! Every cheerleader has [color=#3b78e2][i]two[/i][/color] hands!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I thought you were supposed to be smart!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You guys... I saw what you were doing!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You mean, taking inventory?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Nice try. The only thing you were taking inventory of was her back teeth.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Brendan, do you think you could leave me and Denni alone for some girl talk?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That would make me more comfortable on so many levels!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We'll set up another inventory check later...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Gross.
Brendan eagerly flees the girls' locker room.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're not going to tell anyone, are you, Denni?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Of course not...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Remember? We're in the middle of a case here! We have to follow our leads before they go cold!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, Princess! You've been stalling from the moment you saw it was me you were kissing instead of Buttons over there.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I have not!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes, you have! And this bracelet thing was a pretty convenient reason to keep stalling!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, fine! So I was stalling! I need time, okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... You were `using` my bracelet to stall.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... You were [color=#e23b3b][i]using[/i][/color] my bracelet to stall.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, Ben... It's not like that.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The bracelet `is` important to me. It was just also... Convenient.
nodes.text_bbcode: The bracelet [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] important to me. It was just also... Convenient.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm glad you finally admit it...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm just confused, okay? And the fact is, we `do` need to find this bracelet...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm just confused, okay? And the fact is, we [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] need to find this bracelet...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, then, Denni... Take your time...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I came back for Denni!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You did?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, then...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I guess I've got no beef with you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Good!
Colt looks at Denni and sends her a wink.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks for the warning, Princess.
Ben pulls Denni aside...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You care about him, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Of course I care about him...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I get it, I think...
Spencer gets off of Colt, who glares at Denni!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You couldn't have given me a warning?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He was coming so fast! And... Well... You did kind of deserve it...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nice, Princess. Real nice.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm sorry...
Colt slowly gets to his feet.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Come on, let's just go find Taylor...
After a quiet car ride, Denni, Ben, and Colt walk through the gym, toward the girls' locker room.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: She's not here, she's probably in the locker room...
Denni pushes open the door and stops. Ben and Colt bump into her...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh, hello? `Girls'` locker room?
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, hello? [color=#3b78e2][i]Girls'[/i][/color] locker room?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, right.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Had to try.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Can you be civil out here while I go look for Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: When have I ever been civil?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No promises.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Guys...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but he doesn't know what he's doing with you! He's just going to end up hurting you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm right here! And what I'm doing is better than what `you` ever did!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm right here! And what I'm doing is better than what [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] ever did!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Guys!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's nice that you're here to `protect` her! But when did you get appointed as her guardian angel?!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's nice that you're here to [color=#e23b3b][i]protect[/i][/color] her! But when did you get appointed as her guardian angel?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The moment I saw that she was at that party `alone` while you were off trying to score some cool points!
nodes.text_bbcode: The moment I saw that she was at that party [color=#e23b3b][i]alone[/i][/color] while you were off trying to score some cool points!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You don't know what you're talking about! You don't know what I've been through!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Guys! Enough! I thought we weren't going to talk about this!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't understand why you're running from this, Princess... Why don't we talk about it right now?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah! Why don't we?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Because...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt! Look out!
Colt spins around and sidesteps out of the way in the nick of time!
Spencer flies past him!
Colt marches over and grabs Spencer by the collar! He pulls his fist back for a punch... But stops himself...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's your problem, man?
Spencer shoves him off!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You! You're going to make Sam upset all over again! She's too good to be caught up in any of your crap!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not here for Sam!
Denni doesn't say anything!
Spencer slams into Colt, tackling him to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Oooooof!`

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Stay away from Sam!
Spencer straddles Colt, pulling his fist back!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait! I'm not interested in Sam, you dummy!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You aren't?
Denni extends her hand... Jessica shakes it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: She's at school... I overheard her on the phone say something about working on her cheering, so she's probably in the gym.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And now you owe me one tiny favor! Ooh! Look at that cute guy over there!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why do I get a bad feeling about this?
Jessica saunters off toward the boy...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks, Denni! I know that probably wasn't ideal, but at least it gets us closer to recovering my bracelet.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No problem...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No! I can't do it! Journalists don't give favors! It's unethical!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine! Your loss!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ooh! Look at that cute guy over there!
Jessica saunters off toward the guy...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I understand why you chose not to take her deal, but what are we going to do now?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, we're out of leads!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Maybe we can question someone else?
Later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where are we?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The middle of nowhere!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Look, Amanda said that she saw the bracelet up on this hill...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, but she also said she saw a puppy wearing a kimono.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Good point...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know... This place seems really specific... Would she really guide us somewhere she's never been?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But why would Amanda say the bracelet was in a graveyard?
A big plume of smoke crackles in the air! Amanda appears!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, hey, guys!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `YAH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]YAH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `WHOA!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]WHOA![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uhhh... Hey, Amanda. You just materialized from thin air!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hee hee! I did!
The group slowly backs away from Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Also, you look... Different.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I `feel` different too! And don't take this the wrong way, any of you guys... But I am `so` hungry!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]feel[/i][/color] different too! And don't take this the wrong way, any of you guys... But I am [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] hungry!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: For... For... For blood?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hee hee hee... Of course! I `am` a vampire now!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hee hee hee... Of course! I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] a vampire now!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let me take care of this...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Amanda! If you suck our blood, we won't be your friends anymore!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Awww, why not?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We won't have any blood in our systems! Without the ability of blood to bring oxygen to our brains...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ew! Too much science! Be quiet, both of you!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nice going, Tweed!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Me? It's Denni's fault...
Ben turns to Denni...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You and your journalistic integrity!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All right, yes, if I had known it would end like `this,` I would have done the stupid favor for Jessica!
nodes.text_bbcode: All right, yes, if I had known it would end like [color=#3b78e2][i]this,[/i][/color] I would have done the stupid favor for Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Enough!
Amanda lunges toward them!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Pony feast!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: There's a girl with a devil tail... Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Uh, do I `look` like a 'Jessica'? That name is `so` middle class!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, do I [color=#3b78e2][i]look[/i][/color] like a 'Jessica'? That name is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] middle class!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sorry, forgot to check my economic class checklist...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Never mind...
Denni resumes looking...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All I see are girls with cat whiskers or no costume at all!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh wait! That girl has bunny ears! Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, hi, Denni! I'm not Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Unless, I `am` Jessica?
nodes.text_bbcode: Unless, I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's okay, Amanda. You're not Jessica... I just got your description of her costume messed up...
Across the way, Ben and Colt wave Denni over. She goes over to them...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I found Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, `I` found her. I don't get confused when other people wear costumes...
nodes.text_bbcode: No, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] found her. I don't get confused when other people wear costumes...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Harsh.
Denni, Ben, and Colt reach the party at Hector's house!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey, Hector! How'd you throw this together so quickly?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: My pad is always rigged to be a backup party spot! Check it out...
On Hector's roof is a large empty canvas. He points a remote control at it and presses a button!
A banner falls down that says, 'No one works on Labor Day!'

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Boom! Labor Day party!
He presses another button on the control.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aaaaaand boom!
The new banner says, 'Hector the Underpants Collector!'

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ignore that one... That's a... Joke party!
One more press of the button, and the banner says, 'Happy Halloween 2008!'

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Party B is on! And... It's set in the past!
Everyone cheers! As Denni, Ben, and Colt look for Jessica, they pass girls dressed as bunnies, cats, devils, and angels.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So many people!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's like the whole school is here! And all the girls are wearing the same risque outfits.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, so risque. It's horrible.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm too mad at you to even dignify that comment...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It `is` actually horrible! How are we going to find Jessica in this crowd?!
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] actually horrible! How are we going to find Jessica in this crowd?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's Amanda! She's the only one with long bunny ears! Maybe she knows where Jessica is!
The three of them approach Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hi, Denni! Hi, Ben! Gasp! Pony! You're back! Look at me, I'm a bunny now!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Have you seen Jessica around?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I have! Her outfit is `so` cute!
nodes.text_bbcode: I have! Her outfit is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] cute!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Is it different from all these other Halloween outfits?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It is! It's the most different!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: She's got devil tights, a bunny tail, angel wings, and cat whiskers... But I think she took the whiskers off!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I hope she still gets nine lives!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm sure she will... Thanks, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All right, guys, let's spread out and see if we can find her...
Denni makes her way through the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I've got to find Jessica... If I can get that bracelet back, it might go a long way toward righting things with Ben!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What did Amanda say Jessica was wearing? Devil tights, a bunny tail, angel wings, and cat whiskers... But she took the whiskers off...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Forget about it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Fine.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Did you guys actually need me for something? Or am I supposed to just listen to you fight?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sorry, Jessica, we've been trying to track down a bracelet of Ben's that got stolen...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That was `your` bracelet?!
nodes.text_bbcode: That was [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] bracelet?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I told that Ryan creep I wasn't going to go on a date with him, but then he gave me that bracelet anyway. He told me he found it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, he `found` it inside my dresser...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, he [color=#e23b3b][i]found[/i][/color] it inside my dresser...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm really sorry, Ben. I would never steal, especially not from someone who threw such an `awesome` party! I got like seven guys' numbers!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm really sorry, Ben. I would never steal, especially not from someone who threw such an [color=#3b78e2][i]awesome[/i][/color] party! I got like seven guys' numbers!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks! Could I please get the bracelet back now?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, I don't have it anymore!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What?! Where is it?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Taylor took it from me at Ben's party! She said if I didn't give it to her, she'd demote me all the way to the bottom of the pyramid! I've spent `months` getting up to the second row!
nodes.text_bbcode: Taylor took it from me at Ben's party! She said if I didn't give it to her, she'd demote me all the way to the bottom of the pyramid! I've spent [color=#3b78e2][i]months[/i][/color] getting up to the second row!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ever since $ZOE won Homecoming Queen, Taylor's been taking out all her anger on the cheerleaders! Someone should do something!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Do you know where she is?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Could you tell us?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What's in it for me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? How about you get to do something nice?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How about... No?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah? How about we don't take those shades off the top of your head and...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't have to take this! As far as I'm concerned you need info from me! And I don't have to give it without some kind of compensation!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What did you have in mind?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nothing much... Just a favor. You're a writer for the paper, so I'm sure it'll come in handy to have your assistance later on...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I kind of like having journalistic integrity... What happens if I don't accept your deal?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Then it's super simple. No deal... No info on where Taylor is...
Denni looks at Ben...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I really hope she still has that bracelet...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm sure she does! And you'll finally be able to give the bracelet to your mom!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait wait wait! Hold up... I didn't think of it before but... Tweed, you got your `mom` a bracelet? Who `does` that?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait wait wait! Hold up... I didn't think of it before but... Tweed, you got your [color=#e23b3b][i]mom[/i][/color] a bracelet? Who [color=#e23b3b][i]does[/i][/color] that?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni, come on... This guy isn't right for you! He's too squeaky clean! He's too...
At that moment, Spencer comes barreling out of the crowd, charging right for Colt's back!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grrr!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What did you have in mind?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nothing much... Just a favor. You're a writer for the paper, so I'm sure it'll come in handy to have your assistance later on...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I kind of like having journalistic integrity... What happens if I don't accept your deal?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Then it's super simple. No deal... No info on where Taylor is...
Denni looks at Ben...
Except for one sitting on the front porch, with an image of a pumpkin carved into it!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Meta-pumpkin lives!
Ben reaches inside the pumpkin and pulls out a bracelet!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's beautiful!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't believe we found it! We did it!
Ben and Denni hug! Then Denni looks at Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't worry, you're not gonna hurt my feelings. You ready to talk about this whole fiasco?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ben, is it all right if I talk to Colt alone for a second?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess... Just, keep an eye on your wallet.
Denni pulls Colt aside.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So? You gonna dump Tweed for me?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I didn't think so...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Where were you, huh? Where'd you disappear to? Sam found your house completely empty!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it turns out my dad took my absence as a sign he should move to an even crappier apartment. I'm still seeing what I can do about that...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So you didn't go with them?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I had to go out on my own, okay?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why didn't you say anything? Anything! An email! A text!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What good would it have done?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It would have kept me from hating you every second that I was worried sick about you!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So... That's it? We're not happening?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm... I'm with Ben now.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're making a mistake! Trust me, he's going to hurt you!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I find that pretty ironic coming from you...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whatever...
He starts to walk away...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I thought you were done running from your problems!
He stops and turns back to her...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You were my only problem.
He turns again and leaves...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt...
Denni returns to the front porch and sits on the top step next to Ben...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He seemed pretty upset...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He's hurt.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah. I told him I was interested in another guy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Who? Is it Ryan?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, it's not Ryan. It's someone I can count on. Someone sweet and smart who's really dependable.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That sounds a lot like Ryan.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Heh...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Can you forgive me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: For kissing Colt? Never.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But for kissing Colt because you thought he was me? I think I can forgive that one...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: For what it's worth, up till then, it was a pretty good party... Though I could have used more time with the host...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess I'm just a popular guy now!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That'll take some getting used to!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Can you get used to...
Ben leans into Denni...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: To this?
He kisses her, holding her close!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Mmmm...
After a long while, they separate...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I think I could get used to that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Our second kiss... I think that makes us a couple...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I thought it took more than two kisses...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know, this bracelet... It's not actually for my mom... It's... It's for you.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What?! I can't accept this! It's too expensive... Plus, I'm not an evening gown type of gal, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know... But how often have you actually had the chance to pass up an evening gown event?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Heh... Never.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Exactly. And if you're going to be dating me, there might be some fancy occasions in your future!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, so we're dating now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes, two kisses equal dating.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I didn't know you were keeping track... We'll have to improve our numbers!
Denni brings Ben in for another kiss!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Three kisses is more than two...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Stop counting and kiss me...
They stay that way, close, kissing each other beneath the light of the moon.
Awww... Ben and Denni had their second kiss, and their third, and more! All thanks to you!
You played a great game! You helped Denni sort out her feelings toward Colt and Ben! Congratulations!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's not here! Our pumpkin... It got destroyed!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Who cares about the pumpkin?! My bracelet is gone! Someone must have been lying!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Tweed.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Ben!` My name is `Ben!` Tweed is a rough fabric! All my shirts are distinctly cotton! I can't believe you're even remotely interested in this guy, Denni! All he does is come up with insipid nicknames for everyone!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ben![/i][/color] My name is [color=#e23b3b][i]Ben![/i][/color] Tweed is a rough fabric! All my shirts are distinctly cotton! I can't believe you're even remotely interested in this guy, Denni! All he does is come up with insipid nicknames for everyone!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ben, calm down...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I will not calm down! I will not stand by! Colt, you can have her!
Ben storms back inside his house and slams the door!

nodes.speaker: Denni

nodes.title: Halloween: The Second Kiss, Part Two
nodes.subtitle: Can Denni make things right with Ben?

nodes.text: At Ben's Masquerade Ball, Denni dances with a masked Colt, mistakenly thinking he's Ben...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Did you have a life-altering epiphany?

nodes.speaker: Masked Guy
nodes.text: Something like that...

nodes.speaker: Masked Guy
nodes.text: I realized that you're the one I want.

nodes.speaker: Masked Guy
nodes.text: Even though who knows what it is you see in me...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are you fishing for compliments?

nodes.speaker: Masked Guy
nodes.text: Just curious... We're not exactly a likely pair.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I guess I have a thing for guys with brown hair.

nodes.speaker: Masked Guy
nodes.text: Seriously, Princess...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't know... We've got a certain rapport.

nodes.speaker: Masked Guy
nodes.text: I know what you mean.

nodes.speaker: Masked Guy
nodes.text: I'm sorry I didn't come here earlier... I... Had some things I had to do.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know... I expected it.

nodes.speaker: Masked Guy
nodes.text: See? You get me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Careful now... We're starting to sound like a couple.

nodes.speaker: Masked Guy
nodes.text: That's not the worst thing...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But we still haven't had that all-important second kiss...
He stops dancing, cradling her. The music flows over them...
And he leans forward into a long, tender kiss.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Mmmm...
At that moment, Ben steps onto the dance floor!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni?! Who are you kissing?!
Denni pulls away from the masked guy!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ben?! Wait! Then who... Who are you?
The masked guy removes his mask...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I thought you knew it was me!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I can't believe this happened!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How... How could you kiss `him... Again?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: How... How could you kiss [color=#e23b3b][i]him... Again?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ben, wait! I didn't know... I... I thought he was you! It was...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? An accident? I'm having a lot of trouble believing `that,` considering how frequently you `accidentally` kiss him!
nodes.text_bbcode: What? An accident? I'm having a lot of trouble believing [color=#e23b3b][i]that,[/i][/color] considering how frequently you [color=#e23b3b][i]accidentally[/i][/color] kiss him!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait, wait, wait... You kissed `me` thinking I was `him?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, wait, wait... You kissed [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] thinking I was [color=#e23b3b][i]him?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, I did! I like him!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But he's so... So preppy!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can't believe I came back for you, and you're into Tweed-and-Buttons here!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This shirt is cotton!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You... You came back for me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I did. I've `changed,` Princess... I meant what I said... You're the one I want...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I did. I've [color=#e23b3b][i]changed,[/i][/color] Princess... I meant what I said... You're the one I want...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? You're not seriously falling for that, are you, Denni?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Something about Colt seems different, like maybe he `has` changed... But I like Ben now...
nodes.text_bbcode: Something about Colt seems different, like maybe he [color=#3b78e2][i]has[/i][/color] changed... But I like Ben now...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni? Do you like Colt?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ben...
